packages.name: kotlinx.coroutines.test
packages.purpose: Coroutine test scheduler, dispatchers, TestScope, and Dispatchers.Main replacement.

signature_patterns: fun runTest(context: CoroutineContext = EmptyCoroutineContext, dispatchTimeoutMs: Long = DEFAULT_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS, testBody: suspend TestScope.() -> Unit): TestResult
fun TestScope.runTest(dispatchTimeoutMs: Long = DEFAULT_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS, testBody: suspend TestScope.() -> Unit): TestResult
api.purpose: Run coroutine tests with virtual time and uncaught-exception handling.
Shared virtual time scheduler used by TestDispatcher and TestScope.
CoroutineScope integrated with runTest and virtual time.
Create a standalone TestScope for setup/teardown or shared scheduler tests.
CoroutineDispatcher whose delays are controlled by TestCoroutineScheduler.

signature_patterns: fun StandardTestDispatcher(scheduler: TestCoroutineScheduler? = null, name: String? = null): TestDispatcher
api.purpose: Queued deterministic test dispatcher; launched coroutines need scheduler advancement/runCurrent/yield.

signature_patterns: fun UnconfinedTestDispatcher(scheduler: TestCoroutineScheduler? = null, name: String? = null): TestDispatcher
api.purpose: Unconfined-like test dispatcher; enters top-level children eagerly in runTest.
Run tasks scheduled at current virtual time.
Advance virtual time by a duration.
Return type used for multiplatform runTest compatibility.
Deprecated old test dispatcher. Avoid in generated tests.
Deprecated old test scope. Use TestScope/runTest.
Deprecated old coroutine test runner. Use runTest.

rag_usage_hints: Use StandardTestDispatcher for deterministic scheduling and call runCurrent/advanceUntilIdle as needed.
Use Dispatchers.setMain(testDispatcher) in setup and Dispatchers.resetMain() in teardown for ViewModel/Main dispatcher tests.
Use backgroundScope for infinite/background jobs inside runTest.
